title: Number of people under 5 with anxiety disorders
subtitle: Estimated number of people under 5 who have [anxiety disorders](#dod:anxiety_disorders), whether or not they are diagnosed, based on representative surveys, medical data, and statistical modeling. Prevalence is measured as the number experiencing anxiety disorders at a given point in time. It does not measure lifetime prevalence.
